sections.heading: What Makes a Jewelry Presentation Box Fit for Sourcing?
sections.text: Fine Jewelry Packaging What Makes a Jewelry Presentation Box Fit for Sourcing? The insert must secure the exact pieces without marking them, while the lid angle and reveal remain stable at the retail counter. Start with product dimensions, chain length, earring-post clearance, ring size range and preferred removal motion; then approve the full packed sample rather than an empty box. Velvet colour and pile can shift under different light, so approve a physical swatch beside the jewelry and brand reference. A card slot should be sized from the finished card, including thickness, and tested so it stays visible without interfering with the lid. sections.heading: What Changes the Quote?
sections.text: Procurement & Budgeting What Changes the Quote? Ask each supplier to quote the same packed-product specification. Empty-box dimensions alone are not enough to compare insert, velvet, finishing and transport protection. sections.heading: Send These Inputs for a Comparable Quote
sections.text: RFQ Checklist Send These Inputs for a Comparable Quote Use one brief for every supplier so differences in price reflect the same scope: Product Map List every piece, finished dimensions, weight, chain path, posts and required presentation orientation. Insert & Surface State retention, removal, surface-contact limits, velvet colour and any card or booklet position. Artwork & Finish Attach vector artwork, colour references, foil area, exterior wrap and inside-lid branding. Commercial Scope State target quantity, sampling requirement, destination, delivery window, packing and Incoterm.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.text: Questions Frequently Asked Questions What insert layouts are available for jewelry presentation boxes? Layouts can hold rings, earrings, necklaces, bracelets or combination sets. The cavity, slots and retention points should be designed from the actual pieces and approved with a packed-product sample. Can the lid stay open for counter display? A clamshell hinge can be specified for counter display, but the opening angle and holding force should be confirmed on the physical sample with the intended insert and jewelry weight. What is the MOQ for custom jewelry presentation boxes? Feasible order quantity depends on box dimensions, insert tooling, velvet colour, artwork and finishing setup. Submit the full specification and target volume for confirmation. Can the velvet colour match my brand? Standard and custom colours may be available depending on the insert process and volume. Approve a physical material swatch under your retail lighting before production. Can you add a slot for our brand or authenticity card? Yes. Supply the finished card dimensions, thickness and preferred reveal angle so the slot can be included in the insert drawing and checked during sampling.
